route_note: Take the JR Yamatoji Rapid or Kintetsu Limited Express from central Osaka; both reach Nara in under an hour with no changes, then walk or take a local bus to the park sights.
Frequent JR Special Rapid or Hankyu/Kintetsu limited express trains run direct from Osaka to central Kyoto in about 30-45 minutes, then use local buses or subway to the temples.
JR or Hankyu trains run direct from Osaka to Sannomiya/Kobe in about 25-30 minutes; a local loop bus or ropeway connects to the Kitano and harbor sights.
Take the JR Sanyo Shinkansen or a direct JR Special Rapid from Osaka to Himeji Station, then walk about 15 minutes to the castle.
tour_query: Himeji Castle day trip from Osaka

route_note: Take the Keihan line with a change at Chushojima, or JR to Kyoto and a local line to Uji; the town center and Byodo-in are a short walk from the station.
tour_query: Uji tea and Byodo-in day trip from Osaka
